fields.value: Report an evaluation pass whose matches all errored as failed, and replay errored matches

In manabot MTG-267, two evaluation passes (tla-frontier-c5fba4-gpu-split-v1-76f6eba7fa0c-capacity-1 and tla-frontier-c5fba4-gpu-split-v1-4c5dde665ee0) had every one of their 80 matches end with error 'InferenceFailure: ValueError: checkpoint observation ABI drift', status incomplete and no rows, in about 2 seconds each. Etude still reported each run as 'done: succeeded, 80/80 matches'.

Consequences:

* etude.eval.tournament.played counted the errored matches as delivered, so the experiment's eval() never asked for them again. 640 games of the final comparisons were silently missing.
* The report's coverage showed 0 failed and 0 unplayed for the affected checkpoints.
* The gap only came to light by reading the per-match evaluation.json files in storage.

Outcome:

* A match whose evaluation errored with no rows counts as failed, not played, in run status, in played() and in report coverage.
* A pass whose matches all failed ends failed, not succeeded.
* A later pass replays the failed matches.
* A test covers an all-error pass end to end.
